description: Desktop workbench for managing pi and DSH agent sessions in local project directories
post_install: # app owned userData root: 0.7.x uses %APPDATA%/pi-desktop, main branch renames it to %APPDATA%/PiDeck.
# both names are linked to the same persist dir, so whichever name the app uses ends up in persist
Write-Host "Already linked, leaving it as is: $Source"
if (-not $item.PSIsContainer) { throw "Path exists and is not a directory: $Source" }
Write-Host "Copy to persist failed, keeping the existing dir: $Source"
Write-Host "Moved the previous data dir to: $backup"
Write-Host "Cannot rename the existing dir, skipped linking: $Source"
Write-Host "Linked app data dir to persist: $Source"
# DSH_HOME of the embedded DSH backend is shared with the standalone dsh CLI:
# it is linked only while it holds no data of its own
Write-Host "$Label is already linked, leaving it as is: $Source"
Write-Host "$Label already holds data, it stays outside persist: $Source"
post_uninstall: # Remove-Item -Force can throw a NullReferenceException on junctions in PS 5.1
Write-Host "Removed link, data is kept in persist: $Path"
# app-owned userData dirs are always ours to clean up
# .dsh may be shared with the standalone dsh CLI or deepseek-harness:
# only remove the link when it points at this package's persist dir
Write-Host ".dsh links elsewhere, leaving it alone: $target"
notes: PiDeck 是 pi / DSH Agent 的桌面工作台（Electron + TypeScript），通过 pi --mode rpc 管理本地项目里的 Agent 会话
数据目录（按 0.7.7 发布包与仓库 main 分支源码核对）：
- %APPDATA%\pi-desktop：0.7.7 实际使用的用户数据根；main 分支已更名为 %APPDATA%\PiDeck（首启自行改名迁移）
两个名字都已 Junction 到 persist\data，因此无论应用用哪个名字，数据都落在 persist
其下有 logs 运行日志、pi-runtime 引导安装的便携 Node 与 pi、runtimes\dsh 下载的 DSH runtime、chat-workspace、config-backups、imagegen、instance-locks 等
- %USERPROFILE%\.dsh：DSH_HOME，PiDeck 内嵌的 DSH 后端使用（PiDeck 私有状态在 .dsh\.pideck）。已 Junction 到 persist\dsh-home；未配置或未启动 DSH 后端时该目录可能为空
- %USERPROFILE%\.pi 属于单独安装的 pi CLI（其 agent\ 下的 settings.json、auth.json、models.json、sessions 等，PiDeck 也会写入 mcp.json 与 skills），本包不接管、不做 Junction，由 pi 自己管理
%APPDATA%\pi-desktop 与 %APPDATA%\PiDeck 若已存在，会先整体搬到 persist 并在原位置留下 .backup-<时间戳> 备份
.dsh 只在目录不存在或为空时才建立 Junction：若你已单独装过 dsh CLI，其数据不会被搬动，也不会进入 persist
卸载只删除上述 Junction 链接，persist 中的数据保留；.dsh 的链接仅在其指向本包 persist\dsh-home 时才摘除，若已被 deepseek-harness 等其它包接管则保持原样
PiDeck 依赖 PATH 上的 pi 命令；缺失时可在设置页用「环境引导」一键安装便携 Node + pi，结果落在 persist\data\pi-runtime
应用自带自动更新（默认 AtomGit 源、默认自动下载）：由 Scoop 管理时建议在设置页关闭自动下载更新，改用 scoop update pideck 升级
若在设置页把 DSH_HOME 改到其它路径，persist\dsh-home 的 Junction 对该配置不再生效
「快速任务」等资源管理器右键菜单是 HKCU 注册表集成，不属于 Scoop persist 管理范围，卸载前建议先在应用设置里关闭
